bangumi.summary:
Electro Andes is an animated series set in a future shaped by technology, ecological collapse, and ancient Andean memory.

In Arcadia Iruyana, an Andean settlement oppressed by Black Mountain, a high-tech mega-mine rules with an iron fist. The exploitation of natural resources and human lives has pushed the population to its breaking point.

Against this backdrop, two brothers, Cal and Pietro, join an eco-terrorist cell and descend into the depths of the mine, desperate to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of their grandfather, Tata, who worked in the excavation.

As their search unfolds, the brothers make a pact with ancestral powers in order to confront a technocratic regime that threatens to destroy their world and erase its legacy.
bangumi.name: Electro Andes
